note: Attacker-controlled .ogex file bytes are read into the buffer that is later handed to OpenDDLParser; the trailing NUL appended by TextFileToBuffer is included in the length passed to setBuffer.
Input bytes are copied into the parser's internal m_buffer vector; no extra slack beyond len is guaranteed, so any read at index >= len is out of bounds.
parse() hands the raw buffer to normalizeBuffer before any structural validation, so malformed comment content reaches the unbounded scan.

When the input contains an opening '/*' comment tag with no closing '*/' tag, readIdx is incremented past buffer.size() (len) without any bounds check against len, so the loop keeps dereferencing buffer[readIdx] beyond the end of the vector.
The out-of-bounds read: isCommentCloseTag dereferences &buffer[readIdx] with readIdx >= len, reading one or more bytes past the end of the m_buffer allocation (ASAN heap-buffer-overflow).
